text.body: jaṭāpaṭalakārikā śaiśirīye samāmnāye vyāḍinaiva maharṣiṇā jaṭādyā vikṛtīraṣṭau vakṣyante nātivistaram 1 jaṭā mālā śikhā rekhā dhvajo daṇḍo ratho ghanaḥ aṣṭau vikṛtayaḥ proktāḥ kramapūrvā manīṣibhiḥ 2 brūyātkramaviparyāsakramamīdṛgvidhāṃ diśet jaṭākhyāṃ vikṛtiṃ dhīmān vijñāya kramalakṣaṇam 3 anulomavilomābhyāṃ trivāraṃ hi paṭhetkramam vilome padavatsaṃdhiranulome yathākramam 4 ṣatvaṃ ṇatvaṃ ca dīrghatvaṃ kramasaṃdhau yaducyate vyutkrame tanna kartavyaṃ svarakṣaiprādikaṃ bhavet 5 vilome padavatsaṃdhiranānupūrvyasaṃhite ānupūrvyaṃ krame tyājyaṃ vyutkramaṃ padavatpaṭhet 6 catuḥkrame trikrame ca tathā pañcakrame'pi ca ādyantābhyāṃ trivṛnmadhyaṃ brūyātkramaviparyayaiḥ 7 samayādau krame yadvatsamayātparatastathā jaṭāyāṃ samayādisthaṃ śuddhena parivartayet 8 samayakramaṇaṃ nāsti samayādikramaṃ vinā trikramaṃ samayādisthamādinā saha taṃ paṭhet 9 vyutkrame kramavatsaṃdhiḥ sa ca kṣaiprādiriṣyate ḍakārādividhānaṃ tatsvarāntaḥparivartanam 10 tryakṣarāntapragṛhyāṇāmukārāmantritasya ca vilome padasaṃdhau tu pragṛhyatvaṃ na vidyate 11 ekāraukāraparastvakāro'bhinihanyate vyutkrame kramavaccaiva navadhā kampalopanam 12 vilomasaṃdhau praśliṣṭe kṣaiprābhinihiteṣu ca varjayitvā svaraṃ jātyaṃ triṣu kampaniṣedhanam 13 parigrahāvagraheṣu dvyudāttādipadeṣu ca udāttādividhānaṃ tacchaunakoktaṃ bhavediha 14 ādityairyātamityasminpāde cāṣṭākṣare bhavet padādhyāye'nudāttaḥ syātsaṃhitāyāmudāttavat 15 padadvayamanukramya vyutkramyotmyakra saṃdhivat svaralakṣaṇasaṃyuktā sā jaṭetyabhidhīyate te 16 iti jaṭāpaṭalakārikā
